about_the_game:
Thousands of years ago in the lost continent of Atlantis, wizards are at war.

Since the discovery of orichalcum and it's powers, greedy and corrupt sorcerers are unleashing horrors from the underworld upon the lands in their quest for domination.

The only way to protect your people is to engage in the arm race and stop them before it's too late !

Roam the sky on your magic carpet !

  • Explore monsters infested island on your flying carpet !

  • Look for orichalcum, artifacts and places of power !

  • Compete with other wizards for precious resources or try to keep low profile !

Unleash you spell arsenal !

  •  Gather powerfull spells, from classic fireballs or lightning strikes to more subtle summonings and enchantments !

Conquer islands !

  • Build and expend you base as soon as possible ! It securely store your orichalcum and even allow you to come back from the deads !

  • Gather all the orichalcum you can ! Claim it with your spell and help your balloons bring it back to your castle.

  • Purges the lands from the underworld corruption. And when you're ready take down those whom caused this madness !

content_descriptors.notes:
The game is about playing greedy powerfull wizards rampaging a fictive legendary archipel with powerfull spells and monsters to steal their ressources and ascend to godhood. 

It isn't in any way supposed to reflect reality, but the fact is war is sadly affecting lot of people who can no appreciate fantasises about it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or better
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space

short_description: Fly in the skies with your old magic carpet ! Gather orichalcum and underworld arcanes to fuel your powers and purge Atlantis of rampaging monsters and mad sorcerers. A first shooter with a hint of strategy.
